title: Can I BEAT Martin with No Captures?
summary: Tony tries to beat Martin without ever making a capturing move himself (the whole game; Martin may capture freely). He tries hyper-aggressive mating attacks (Qh5 ideas), but Martin's random captures can never be recaptured and his position 'beta decays'. He loses all four games (~19:14).
rules: The player may NEVER capture any piece for the entire game (including en passant). Only non-capturing moves are legal for the player.
The bot (Martin) plays normal chess and may capture.
If the player's only legal moves are captures (e.g. only escape from check is a capture), the player is effectively stuck (inferred: treat as loss/no legal move).
win_condition: Checkmate Martin without ever capturing (Tony lost 4/4).

board.theme_notes: standard chess.com green; thumbnail 'Capturing is banned' profile card

current_impl_issues: Impl 'nocap' bans captures for BOTH sides only until move 10; video bans captures for the player only, for the whole game.
evidence: 0:01 'defeat the Martin bot without capturing any pieces'; 0:53 'that knight is totally safe' (can't take back); 18:31 Martin +14; 19:14 'we do lose all four games'. Frame visual_b Martin (250).
